name: The Day Before Nightmare
source:
This is a fangame about the day before Leon S. Kennedy arrive Raccoon City. Your will play as Janice, a waitress from a sideroad pub, and you can play with Leon and Ray, a character from the beta of RE2, a.k.a. Resident Evil 1.5.

[From [url=https://orlando-inlove.itch.io/the-day-before-nightmare]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于莱昂·S·肯尼迪抵达浣熊市前一天的粉丝游戏。你将扮演Janice，一个路边酒吧的女服务员，你可以扮演Leon和Ray，他们是《生化危机2》（又名《生化危机1.5》）测试版中的角色。

[来自[url=https://orlando-inlove.itch.io/the-day-before-nightmare]itch.io[/url]]
